scope: RTH SPX/SPXW production-compatible Debit Vertical research only; no strategy_decision or notification authority

data_contract.input: causally available five-second SPX quote-update grid
data_contract.knowledge_guard: quality=live; source/quote clocks not from future; exact BBO fresh at both selection and fill

event_contract.right_breakout: cross prior causal 30-minute high/low on a 60-second decision point
event_contract.right_pullback_resume: 15-minute impulse >= local scale; 0.25-0.80 scale pullback; latest one-minute move resumes impulse direction
event_contract.local_scale: max(2.5 points, 1.25*causal 15-minute realized path volatility); no fixed holding horizon
event_contract.outcome: symmetric first-passage target/stop at one local scale; otherwise censor at RTH close

option_contract.selection: nearest absolute delta using information available at decision_at
option_contract.entry: long ask minus short bid at decision+5s
option_contract.exit: long bid minus short ask at first-passage outcome time

explicit_rejections.right_breakout: production-compatible vertical has negative development session LCB
explicit_rejections.gth_right_breakout: negative validation and tail IBKR exact-BBO economics
explicit_rejections.gth_right_pullback_resume: negative validation and tail IBKR exact-BBO economics

integration_constraint: A future pass may authorize only a Debit Vertical candidate generated from the same raw event contract; adding RIGHT_PULLBACK_RESUME as a human-visible setup still requires explicit candidate-space approval.
